verification.validation: AppShell draws the UI's AppTabBar from its pages on a phone outside a DSM window, with phoneTabs: 'none' to turn it off. Frontend vitest for the shell and related layout tests, typecheck, vite build, a Chromium phone-layout check, sdk-version, executor manifest and documentation version checks, and an internal-content scan of the packed npm tarballs. npm packages packed from this commit. No full gate, target matrix, executor rebuild, Rust build, crate publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: AppShell shows a bottom tab bar on a phone outside a DSM window by default: the UI's AppTabBar with the sidebar's pages, icon only, the current page from v-model; pages it cannot hold go under More, which also opens the navigation drawer. Fewer than two listed pages draw no tab bar. Desktop widths and DSM windows are unchanged.
phoneTabs: 'none' keeps the drawer as the phone navigation; an App's own tabbar slot still replaces the default bar.
